decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The access doorway to the ___________________ shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.

Condition : 5 - AdvertisementsThe proposal hereby permitted refers only to the installation of the new shop front and does not give consent for the display of adverts. Any advert including fascia, hanging or projecting signs should not be displayed without the submission of a separate planning application.REASON: To accord with the Town and country Planning (Control of Advertisement) Regulations 1989.
description: Installation of a new shop front to retail shop.
